title: Checking wrapped errors
hints: Fetch wraps ErrNotFound with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", ...), so the error it returns is a different value. Comparing with == only matches the exact sentinel value.
errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) looks through the whole wrap chain. Also check what happens to errors that are not "not found": they must reach the caller, not be swallowed.
if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) { return def, nil }; if err != nil { return "", err }; return v, nil
